title: Good app, no subscription 🤯
body: Loving it so far. Not sure why I can’t mark a habit in quantity (only allowing me to mark done/not done)
author: KinyanjuiNik

title: Love it!
body: Really great app. Clean, simple and easy to use. Although if I could suggest an improvement, it would be to not send reminders for tasks that have already been marked as done. Other than that I would 100% recommend this!
author: Samri78

title: B
body: This app is so great, I downloaded dozen of app and they all not free and even not good enough as this app, great job 👏🏻
